title: After so many AI bots projects, fable 5 is really a winner (and 2 sales)
author: curioussharma-007
selftext:
I trade Indian equities and got tired of arguing about whether YouTube "strategy" videos actually work. So I built a tool where you paste any strategy video URL (Hindi, Hinglish or English) and it pulls the transcript, has an LLM decode the actual mechanical rules, and runs a real backtest on 10 years of Indian market data with genuine brokerage/STT/slippage costs baked in.

I built most of it pair-programming with Claude's new Fable 5 model, and honestly it was a different experience from earlier models, it caught two money-handling race conditions in my payment code from its own tests, refused to ship a misleading return number in my own backtest engine (I'd computed % return per position instead of on deployed capital, it flagged the 12x inflation), and kept insisting on "honest verdict" states for strategies it couldn't fairly test instead of faking numbers. The classifier is Haiku reading 32k-char transcripts; each analysis costs me about ₹2.

What the data says after running 130+ strategies: **61% lose money after real costs.** The pattern that keeps repeating win-rate claims are usually *true* (one options guru claimed 72%, backtest says 75%!) while the strategy still loses, because the average loss quietly outweighs the average win. High win rate + concave payoff. Every. Single. Time.

400 people have run backtests in the first 5 days, which tells me I'm not the only one having this argument.

If you want to try: [https://app.faketrades.in](https://app.faketrades.in)

Users have tried over 500 YT video based strategies. Even if a particular stratgy is not based In Indian stock market and rather on US/Commodity/Cryto, the script will try the logic on indian stocks and indices, and share the backtest results.

It's free to try (2 backtests/day). Also looking for more possible addons in project

replies.author: curioussharma-007
replies.body:
As per SEBI (Regulatory exchange of India), 97% retail traders lost money last year and 1% made returns equal to fixed deposit i.e 7% per annum. So the data is correct in Indian market and i believe if someone can crack Indian market, they can do it way better in US.

I have personally backtested over 500 different strategies on  rented NVIDIA GPU, with 10 years of data goes upto index/stock level and only 2 of them i found are profitable in last 5 years in every scenerio.  
One is based on currency trading EURINR, USDINR, GPBINR  
and only one on NIFTY index (this one is amazing and I made an auto trading bot for this, testing).

Can you share the place i can get backtest data (10 years atleast) for NQ, ES and GC?

comments.author: Good_Character_20
comments.body: The win rate claims checking out while the strategy still loses might be the most useful finding in here. Win rate is the one stat a viewer can verify on their own by paper trading along for a couple weeks, so it is exactly the stat the videos optimize for. The loss asymmetry that actually drains the account takes a hundred trades and a spreadsheet to see, so it never makes the thumbnail. Honest number, dishonest picture. Since you have upload dates, the addon I would want is a split backtest per video, performance before the upload date versus after it. Gurus tend to film right after a hot streak, so the before window is cherry picked by construction and the after window is the only honest test. My guess is your 61% lose after costs number gets meaningfully worse when you only count the months after publication.
